scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: Dry planters
scenes.caption: The garden club notices dry planters after weekends. Iqbal proposes an AI watering predictor immediately. Nisha asks what problem they actually need to solve.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Make success visible
scenes.caption: They replace make the garden smarter with reduce dry planter checks from six to at most two in the next ten simulated mornings.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the simple plan
scenes.caption: A written weekend schedule might already solve the problem. The club compares it with a prediction proposal using the same held out mornings. They also count unnecessary watering, because reducing dryness by watering constantly could create a different problem for the plants.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose the next step
scenes.caption: Iqbal wants to build before inspecting the logs. Nisha proposes defining the goal, checking useful data, trying a simple baseline and then testing alternatives. Decide which sequence gives the club evidence before it invests effort in a more complicated tool.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: A responsible trial
scenes.caption: The schedule meets the target in this simulation with fewer unnecessary watering events. The club keeps it for now. A teacher remains responsible for real garden decisions; these invented results do not establish what would happen with different plants, seasons or equipment.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Rain changes the brief
scenes.caption: A new fictional forecast introduces heavy rain. Now the club must include overwatering in its success test and review the schedule. In the lab, prepare a project brief, order the investigation and adapt the goal when the conditions change.
